limitations: Only one stock map in each mode was exercised; not exhaustive maps, Force powers, weapon damage combinations, private-recipient UI, team modes or long-duration soak.

Original MotS first join exceeded the30-second activity timeout during emulated rendering startup. The warmed rejoin with ordinary smaller view/system-memory backbuffer remained active for several minutes.
Original client ran slowly under Wine+qemu and intermittently captured black backbuffers. This test does not establish performance on native Windows hardware.
Remote movement is applied but exact coordinate equality is not claimed; measured small steady offsets are retained.
Native normal world death and respawn replicated scores and player state; direct player-versus-player lethal damage is not yet verified.
No Internet/NAT traversal qualification; tests used one isolated local network namespace.
Original retail HUD may include an unspawned dedicated host row; authoritative humans exclude it.
final_release_change: Final gateway adds only stale DirectPlay destination cleanup for DPERR_INVALIDPLAYER. Protocol conversion unchanged; final-binary rejoin and ordinary departure continuity PASS in retail-mots-disconnect.json.
